scope: Independent static source/JSON review of V1 only; not execution approval, model validation, quality judgment or scientific verdict.

Palette mapping, first actual cue policy, accent threshold >=0.5, strength0.35, full width0.25s, max overlap and frozen NMS calls match original infer_overlay.py.

resource_static.raw_bound_method: Fixed source schemas;3 shared plus1 independent contexts; max1387 accents and555 color cues from frozen spacing; omit duplicate baseline and probabilities. No output arrays read.
resource_static.required_placement_change: Sibling workspace explicitly aggregated with original and whole end-to-end artifacts under unchanged cap; not a new campaign budget.

findings.title: Derived output changes finalized original campaign tree
findings.evidence: guard explicitly requires derived_root inside campaign_root; preflight creates that directory. No existing file must be overwritten for the finalized tree inventory to change.
findings.required_action: Use a new sibling/versioned delivery workspace. Bind an explicit aggregate list including original campaign plus the whole end-to-end workspace and every previous/partial delivery output. Retain original CAP=1020054732 and shared 32MiB reservation; do not reset the budget. Snapshot original tree hashes/inventory before and after. Parent reports this correction is already requested for V2.

findings.title: Readback checks byte arithmetic but not the origin/semantics of saved decisions
findings.evidence: verify_mapping trusts saved accent_times_s, accent_confidences, palette_rgb and color_cues. It never recomputes accent peak/NMS/threshold from accent_score; never derives RGB/HSV/z from bound prototypes; never derives color_cues from color logits/scores; never compares generated ids with saved palette_logits argmax at initialization/cues; never checks final_ids. Current test synthetic(cue=True) uses all-zero palette_logits but id1 after the cue, which the verifier is designed to accept. This is a source-level counterexample, not an executed test result.
findings.required_action: Make zero-model-call verification derive the exact frozen cue/accent rules from saved raw scores and validate sigmoid score/logit agreement, frozen palette summary, recurrence, initialization argmax, cue argmax and final state. Require exact saved schema/shapes/dtypes first. Then retain independent RGB/dimmer/protected-byte reconstruction. Add mutations that each violate these contracts.

findings.title: Generated-history all-state palette table can hide nonfinite outputs before argmax
findings.evidence: generated_history calls palette_logits(...).argmax before returning only integer choices. full_forward checks saved context, logits on realized previous states and integer rollout only. A nonfinite value in an unvisited all-state table entry is not necessarily seen by these checks.
findings.required_action: A transparent inference proxy must check finiteness of every canonical palette_logits result before argmax without an extra model call or arithmetic change. Add NaN/Inf synthetic cases. Parent independently identified and requested this for V2; frozen training source must stay unchanged.

findings.title: Native-test receipt guard does not enforce the handoff receipt schema
findings.evidence: authorize checks receipt hash, status, source/test maps and zero read/forward counters. It ignores exit_code, command, log identity/hash and test count. A receipt with status=passed and exit_code=1 or missing command/log fields passes these conditions.
findings.required_action: Validate native wrapper/command/environment, successful exit, nonempty expected test execution and bound log before authorizing inference. Bind the receipt to exact plan/test/source versions. Parent-produced receipt must not infer success only from status strings.

findings.title: Standalone verification does not authenticate saved provenance against current authorization
findings.evidence: verify_saved validates recipe/checkpoint and self-referenced NPZ hashes only. It does not compare saved plan, authorization, inputs or source_files against current bound values. verify phase also ignores complete.json and its authenticated inference/proof links. A different-plan inference sidecar with the same recipe/checkpoint can be accepted if its reconstructed baseline bytes match.
findings.required_action: Validate exact plan, permitted phase authorization, inputs, source bindings, within-arm artifact paths and completion/readback chain before treating saved output as this delivery. Preserve the no-model-call verification path; do not recover by repeating the forward.

findings.title: Eager transitive project imports are absent from source binding
findings.evidence: Importing overlay -> dmx.fixtures executes dmx/__init__.py, which imports scenes.py and universe.py. These import audio anticipation/features/structure and execute audio/__init__.py. These six project files are absent from source_files although executed by Mapping tests and inference imports.
findings.required_action: Bind lightsem/dmx/{scenes,universe}.py and lightsem/audio/{__init__,anticipation,features,structure}.py in the new version. Do not edit frozen packages. Native tests must run with librosa/scipy/sklearn available in the dedicated torch environment.

findings.title: Current tests do not exercise full_forward or semantic readback
findings.evidence: The factory test calls a fake loader that returns the expected fake config and directly calls that fake model; it never calls full_forward, the canonical loader/factory, or the generated-history path. Storage tests mock guard during actual writes; no partial-file accounting or multi-arm interruption/skip test is present. No authorization/receipt acceptance test is present. full_forward only validates output keyset and context shape, not raw head/rollout shape/dtype contracts.
findings.required_action: Add synthetic schema/finite/history/mapping/provenance/receipt mutations and filesystem partial/interruption tests. Test orchestration with fake hooks, not a real checkpoint/model forward. Keep real checkpoint loading and all four full-song forwards behind reviewed native-test and parent authorization gates.

findings.title: Aggregate media enforcement remains a parent-side prerequisite; inference completion is not video completion
findings.evidence: New driver never renders. It writes all_complete.json with a delivery-videos scope before any render/audit. Frozen renderer caps each arm at512MiB rather than all four at1.5GiB; audit sheet writes lack an aggregate guard. Handoff explicitly delegates this enforcement to parent, so the listed render commands alone are not a complete guarded delivery runner.
findings.required_action: Name inference/mapping completion narrowly. Before frozen render calls, parent must enforce aggregate root media reservation/cap/free floor including partial videos, logs, sheets and audits across all arms, plus exclusive dirs/no rerender of anchor. Final delivery receipt requires all four native1080p AV1/audio renders and audits.

delivery_scope: Deliver all four full Shpongle videos regardless of apparent quality. Ashuf recipient audio is a disclosed delivery route, not primary donor-route evaluation. Never infer/rerender unchanged anchor to repair this driver. Human audiovisual acceptance remains distinct from media audit.
